cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.20)
project(AnimationAuthoringExamples LANGUAGES CXX)
add_executable(animation_suite_example suite_example.cpp)
add_executable(animation_suite_fixture suite_fixture.cpp)
option(ANIMATION_EXAMPLES_ASAN "Check the portable examples with AddressSanitizer" OFF)
foreach(example_target animation_suite_example animation_suite_fixture)
target_compile_features(${example_target} PRIVATE cxx_std_20)
if(MSVC)
    target_compile_options(${example_target} PRIVATE /utf-8 /W4 /WX)
    if(ANIMATION_EXAMPLES_ASAN)
        target_compile_options(${example_target} PRIVATE /fsanitize=address /Zi)
        target_link_options(${example_target} PRIVATE /INCREMENTAL:NO /DEBUG)
    endif()
else()
    target_compile_options(${example_target} PRIVATE -Wall -Wextra -Wpedantic -Werror)
    if(ANIMATION_EXAMPLES_ASAN)
        target_compile_options(${example_target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
        target_link_options(${example_target} PRIVATE -fsanitize=address,undefined)
    endif()
endif()
endforeach()
enable_testing()
add_test(NAME portable_animation_suite COMMAND animation_suite_example)
add_test(NAME portable_animation_fixture COMMAND animation_suite_fixture)
